about: A Flutter app with a local package by path and a Cloudflare Worker it calls: the app is one module (android/ and ios/ are its platforms), the package another, and the Worker is served at the host its wrangler.toml routes name, so a module that writes that host calls it.
nearMisses: android/app/build.gradle.kts is the app's Android build, folded into the app and not a Java module of its own
flutter and flutter_test are SDK packages, declared with sdk: flutter
api.shop.example is a reserved test name, not an external resource
test/widget_test.dart is a test and does not make the app an entry point twice
https://api.shopapp.dev/v1/prices in the package is the Worker's own address, not an external API, and its GET /v1/prices is provided
wrangler and typescript are command-line tools, not imports
packages/ui names the host only in a comment, in a look-alike (xapi.…), as the start of a longer host and in its test: it calls nothing
tools/report is referenced by nothing, and is not an orphan: tool/report.dart has a main() and is run with dart run
